comments.content: Myth-bust from this episode: the famous "Colgate Beef Lasagna" image isn't real. Colgate did test frozen chicken and crabmeat entrees in 1964, though. Ew. So the truth is a toothpaste company selling frozen crab dinners, which isn't any better.

The Nintendo Power Glove had about 5 months to go from lab prototype to trending Xmas gifts for 1989. But the Power Glove got cheaper finger sensors to hit the deadline, and launched only one game built for it. Years later it's cited as part of the road to the Wii Remote. The long game is weird.
